Also joining us recently was Linda Nicholls who will be able to compete in the team in a few months. (She was quickly followed by her brother Michael).

Shirley Rook beat Anna Matthews home by 1 second in the Southern Counties 5000 metre race on January 28th at Maidstone. They crossed the line in 5th and 6th places, 28:24 and 28:25, with Linda Nicholls not far away in 11th place, 30:49.
The last championship was the Southern Counties at Maidstone and this race saw the first appearance of Linda Nicholls, the Kent Champion, in Belgrave colours.

Exams and other commitments have rather restricted progress but with these now out of the way for most of them, we can look forward to a hard and successful winter with full team turn outs now that Linda Nicholls has become eligible for team events.
Linda Nicholls (Kent) finished 9th in 17:22 and was unlucky not to get a team medal. Kent tied with Hereford and Worcester for 3rd place but were placed fourth under A.A.A.
